notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-ed8edfcb5a11, DOI 10.1128/msystems.00184-16, PMCID PMC5361782. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the cold-seep sponge symbiont study.
source_text: The DNA samples from layers A and E were subjected to library construction and sequenced using the Illumina HiSeq2000 platform in Novegene (Beijing, China). The sponge cell- and prokaryotic cell-enriched DNA samples were subjected to library construction and sequenced using the MiSeq platform with a library size of 500 bp and an average read length of 251 bp.
